key_findings: Hydroxytyrosol reduced TNF-alpha-induced COX-2, iNOS, NLRP3, MMP-13 and ADAMTS-4 in nucleus pulposus cells via NF-kB inhibition and protected rat discs from needle-puncture degeneration.
Intrathecal HT improved CCD-induced pain thresholds and reduced spinal dorsal horn COX-2, IL-1beta, p-ERK and p-AKT.
